landing.subhead: Empowering South Asian students and job seekers with instant, explainable 5-Agent AI scam verification for job offers, emails, WhatsApp messages, and recruiter URLs.
landing.demo_title: Spot Fake Job Posters vs Genuine Ads
landing.demo_desc: Fraudulent recruiters target students on WhatsApp, Facebook, and Telegram. Here is how SAFE-HIRE's 5-Agent AI automatically identifies high-risk scams.
landing.workflow_desc: An automated multi-agent pipeline analyzes job postings, screenshots, and URLs in seconds.
landing.reviews_desc: See how SAFE-HIRE's 5-Agent AI helps undergraduates and job seekers across South Asia identify job scams, avoid fake fees, and secure authentic opportunities.
landing.feature_1_desc: Automated AI pipeline analyzing text, OCR image screenshots, and WHOIS domain age.
landing.feature_2_desc: Native explanations in English, Sinhala, Tamil, Hindi, and Bengali.
landing.feature_3_desc: Live WHOIS age lookup and Google Safe Browsing reputation check.
landing.feature_4_desc: Clear, student-friendly recommendations to protect your money and identity.
landing.cta_bottom_desc: Join thousands of graduates using SAFE-HIRE to verify job postings before sharing personal details.
landing.action_subtitle: Watch how our multimodal vision OCR engine extracts text, validates recruiter brand identity, and identifies scam red flags in real-time.
landing.action_hud_top: SAFE-HIRE NEURAL VISION CORE V3.6 • LIVE LASER OCR STREAM
landing.action_instant_desc: Our system combines computer vision, natural language processing, and WHOIS cybersecurity verification to flag fraudulent job offers before you apply.
landing.action_feat_1_desc: Extracts text from job flyers, WhatsApp chats, and PDF posters directly.
landing.action_feat_2_desc: Detects brand impersonation, disposable email domains, and newly registered scam URLs.
landing.action_feat_3_desc: Instantly flags registration fee demands, laptop deposits, and payment traps.
landing.agent_card_1_desc: Processes text, image OCR screenshots, and URLs; auto-detects language.
landing.agent_card_2_desc: Evaluates EMSCAD signals: urgency, payment demands, email domain anomalies.
landing.agent_card_3_desc: Checks WHOIS domain age, Google Safe Browsing, Abstract Email validation, and corporate presence.
landing.agent_card_4_desc: Synthesizes signals into a 0-100 score with plain language explanation.
landing.agent_card_5_desc: Delivers tailored safety guidance and university reporting steps.
landing.gallery_title: Spot Fake Job Posters vs Genuine Ads

landing.why_choose_desc_2: Native explanations in English, Sinhala, Tamil, Hindi, and Bengali for localized fraud detection across South Asia.

landing.why_choose_desc_4: Clear, student-friendly recommendations to protect your money, identity, and career credentials against hiring fraud.
